s.en: Foo-over-UDP receive port configuration ip-gue - Generic UDP Encapsulation receive port configuration

syn: ip [ OPTIONS ] fou { COMMAND | help } ⏎ ip fou add port PORT { gue | ipproto PROTO } [ local IFADDR ] [ peer IFADDR ] [ peer_port PORT ] [ dev IFNAME ] ⏎ ip fou del port PORT [ local IFADDR ] [ peer IFADDR ] [ peer_port PORT ] [ dev IFNAME ] ⏎ ip fou show
